description: Per-pod drill-down for DACS cache servers: requests, latency, connection and accept-queue health, file descriptors, request sizes and space used.

panels.description: One row per cache server pod. Rates are averaged over the last 5 minutes. "Up" is 1 when the last scrape of the pod succeeded.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, cache, pod) (up{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (namespace, cache, pod) (rate(cache_server_request_counter{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod", request_type!~"Unknown"}[5m]))

sum by (namespace, cache, pod) (rate(cache_server_request_counter{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod", request_type="Download", status="Success"}[5m]))
/
sum by (namespace, cache, pod) (rate(cache_server_request_counter{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod", request_type="Download", status=~"Success|InvalidTransition"}[5m]))
max by (namespace, cache, pod) (cache_server_active_connections{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"})
max by (namespace, cache, pod) (cache_server_cache_size_bytes{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Cache servers

panels.description: Request rate handled by each cache server. Clients pick a server by hashing the cache key, so load should be roughly even; a flat line on one pod usually means clients cannot reach it.
panels.title: Requests by pod

panels.description: Download hits divided by download lookups for each server. A single pod with a low ratio was probably restarted or rescheduled and is refilling.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(cache_server_request_counter{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod", request_type="Download", status="Success"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(cache_server_request_counter{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod", request_type="Download", status=~"Success|InvalidTransition"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Hit ratio by pod

panels.description: Requests that ended with status BadRequest|InternalError|NetworkError|NotSet. NetworkError means the connection broke while a request or response was in flight; InternalError includes cache state that no longer matches the files on disk.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, status) (rate(cache_server_request_counter{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod", request_type!~"Unknown", status=~"BadRequest|InternalError|NetworkError|NotSet"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Errors by pod and status

panels.description: Connections that were closed, or sent something unparseable, before a request could be read. They are recorded as request_type Unknown and are left out of error ratios.
panels.title: Aborted connections

panels.description: p99 server-side latency of successful downloads per pod. Buckets top out at 10 s.
panels.title: Download latency p99 by pod

panels.description: p99 server-side latency of successful uploads per pod, including the write to cache storage.
panels.title: Upload latency p99 by pod

panels.description: Distribution of successful download latency across the selected pods.
panels.title: Download latency distribution

panels.description: Requests currently being handled by worker threads (cache_server_active_connections). Despite the name this is not the number of open sockets; it is bounded by the server thread pool (spec.serverThreads).
panels.title: In-flight requests

panels.description: Passively opened TCP connections per second in the pod network namespace (Tcp.PassiveOpens). The server samples kernel counters once a minute.
panels.title: New connections

panels.description: Backlog the server passed to listen(). The effective accept queue is also capped by net.core.somaxconn.
panels.title: Listen backlog

panels.description: TcpExt.ListenOverflows (accept queue full) and TcpExt.ListenDrops (any SYN dropped at a listening socket) per second. Anything above zero means clients are failing or retrying connects.
panels.title: Accept queue overflows and listen drops

panels.description: TcpExt.TCPReqQFullDrop (SYN dropped because the request queue was full) and TcpExt.TCPReqQFullDoCookies (SYN cookie sent instead) per second.
panels.title: SYN queue drops and SYN cookies

panels.description: Failed accept() calls by errno. 24 (EMFILE) and 23 (ENFILE) mean file descriptors ran out.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, errno) (rate(cache_server_accept_errors_total{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: accept() errors

panels.description: cache_server_open_fds, read from /proc/sys/fs/file-nr. That file is system-wide, so this is the number of file handles allocated on the node, not by the cache server process alone.
panels.title: Allocated file handles

panels.description: Bytes stored by each cache server. Eviction, when enabled, starts at spec.eviction.sizeThreshold (90% by default) and stops at sizeTarget (80%).
panels.title: Space used by pod

panels.description: Throughput of successful downloads per pod.
panels.title: Bytes served by pod

panels.description: Throughput of successful uploads per pod.
panels.title: Bytes written by pod

panels.description: Mean size of successful downloads. Size buckets are coarse (100 kB, 512 kB, 1 MB, 4 MB, 16 MB), so only the average is shown per pod.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(cache_server_download_request_size_bytes_sum{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(cache_server_download_request_size_bytes_count{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average download size

panels.description: Mean size of successful uploads.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(cache_server_upload_request_size_bytes_sum{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(cache_server_upload_request_size_bytes_count{job="dacs-cache-server", namespace=~"$namespace", cache=~"$cache", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average upload size

panels.description: Distribution of successful download sizes across the selected pods.
panels.title: Download size distribution

panels.description: Distribution of successful upload sizes across the selected pods.
panels.title: Upload size distribution
